request: Option A contents in option C's simplified bold style, three distinct variants.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: new Steam capsule key art variant 1, "Connected landscape", landscape 1536x1024 or larger.
Reference image 1 is CONTENT reference A: a transmission pylon, a compact town, wind turbines, solar panels, hydro dam and a power station connected into one electricity landscape.
Reference image 2 is STYLE reference C: extremely simplified bold flat navy/ivory/electric-blue graphic design, large high-contrast silhouettes, sparse purposeful shapes and clean negative space.
User request: combine the CONTENTS of A with the simplified BOLD STYLE of C. This is an intentional hybrid, not a recolor of A.
Primary composition: one strong simplified electric-blue transmission pylon anchors the RIGHT EDGE, a small hydro dam and a broad flat river at bottom left, one bold wind turbine near the middle, a compact group of 4-5 town buildings at lower center-right, a small distinct power station behind the town, and one simple solar array across lower foreground. Connect them with ONE bold blue grid path and three large round junctions. Group the scene into the LOWER HALF and RIGHT THIRD. The upper-left 60% must stay quiet dark navy for the separate existing wordmark.
Style: match reference C's dramatic reduction exactly. Reduce A's small buildings, vegetation, lattice bars, solar panel grid cells and wires radically. Pylon should have only a few structural crossbars, town only chunky geometric buildings and a few amber window squares, dam only 3 large water openings, solar array only 4-6 large cells. Broad diagonal ivory and blue shapes define the landscape, NO scenic painting or realistic perspective. Flat fills, crisp strong shapes, confident dark outlines, almost no incidental detail. Navy #102031, electric blue #0084F8, warm ivory, tiny restrained amber windows. Recognizable electricity infrastructure and a served community.
NO TITLE, no lettering, logo, words, numbers, watermark, badges or marketing copy; the actual vector wordmark will be added separately. No gradients, glow, realistic 3D, textures, decorative forests, mountains, tiny trees or dozens of tiny nodes. No chart bars or supply-demand graph: preserve A's infrastructure landscape content.

Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: Steam capsule hybrid variant 2, "Powering the town", landscape 1536x1024.
Image 1 is A's CONTENT reference: power grid, town, hydro dam, solar, wind, and power station. Image 2 is C's STYLE reference: bold reduction, flat geometric silhouettes, broad navy/ivory/blue fields, confident clean shapes.
User wants A's CONTENT in C's simplified BOLD STYLE. Create a genuinely different composition from the large-pylon-on-right idea: make a compact community of SIX large blocky town buildings the focal point at LOWER CENTER-RIGHT. A single bold blue electrical route links the town to a simplified hydro dam at bottom left, one simple solar array in lower center, two bold wind turbines on the middle horizon, and a compact power station to the far right. A smaller clean transmission pylon rises behind the town, not an oversized foreground tower. Show the full interconnected power system supplying a community. Keep the top-left 60% uninterrupted dark navy for the existing wordmark to be composited later.
Graphic style should be as reduced as C: broad angular ivory land bands, flat blue river, chunky navy silhouettes with only a handful of amber square windows. Town buildings should be strong rectangular shapes, no tiny streets or painted scenery. Dam only three water openings; solar only 4-6 large cells; turbines three blades each; pylon minimal crossbars. Three generous blue grid junctions maximum. Clean separation between forms and lots of breathing room. Prefer flat front-facing silhouettes and symbolic geometry over isometric illustration. A sophisticated indie electricity strategy poster.
Palette: deep navy #102031, electric blue #0084F8, warm ivory, restrained amber only for a few town windows. No gradients, glow, textures, foliage, forests, realistic mountains, fine lattice, miniature architectural detail, marketing badges or UI.
No text, lettering, logos, title, numbers, watermark or borders. No finance/chart bars or supply-demand graph. Preserve the concrete infrastructure and town subject of A, dramatically simplified in C's graphic visual language.

Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: Steam capsule hybrid variant 3, "Grid in silhouette", landscape 1536x1024.
Image 1 = CONTENT reference A: connected electricity infrastructure, community, transmission pylon, hydro dam/river, wind, solar and power station. Image 2 = STYLE reference C: very bold flat graphic poster with broad ivory/blue fields, navy silhouettes, clean geometry, confident reduction.
Create the most graphic and simplified of the three hybrids, while keeping ALL the core subjects from A. An elegant broad IVORY DIAGONAL LAND RIBBON rises from lower left to middle right against a deep navy field. On this ribbon arrange a compact power station with two clear chimneys near center, ONE bold turbine on the right with three large navy blades against ivory, a few chunky geometric town buildings at lower right with only 3-4 amber windows, and a solid graphic transmission pylon near the right edge with very sparse triangular cutouts. A stylized three-opening hydro dam at lower LEFT feeds a single electric-blue river shape. One dark solar panel with just FOUR ivory-outlined cells occupies the lower center foreground. One broad blue grid connection sweeps through the sources to the town with at most two circular junctions.
Prioritize bold dark silhouettes against ivory blocks, like reference C, rather than colored little 3D buildings. Keep at least the upper-left 60% dark, calm and empty for the separate original title. Facilities occupy the lower half and right third, each recognizable and clearly separated. No lattice intricacy, no extra perspective, no micro-details, no trees or mountains. River and land are only 2-3 broad flat shapes. Flat electric blue #0084F8, deep navy #102031 and warm ivory; amber only on a few windows. Crisp, sophisticated modernist infrastructure poster, large shapes and strong negative space.
NO TEXT OR LOGO: no title, words, letters, numbers, watermark, border, badges, slogans, labels, pseudo UI, chart bars, gradients, glow or textures. This must have A's tangible power system and community, reduced to C's beautifully simple graphic silhouettes.
